safi-cedvel:15-16.t:
* I'rab:
((الفاء) resumptive (أمّا) a particle of condition and elaboration (الذين) a relative noun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject) (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis of أمّا (في روضة) attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هم [Note: or attached to (يحبرون), the clause يحبرون being the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).], and the (الواو) in (يحبرون) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «الذين آمنوا..» has no grammatical position (resumptive).
The clause «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين)).
The clause «عملوا..» has no grammatical position (conjoined to the ṣila clause).
The clause «هم في روضة..» is in the position of a nominative (khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين)).
The clause «يحبرون..» is in the position of a nominative (a second khabar).
(16) (الواو) a conjunction (أمّا الذين كفروا ... ) like أمّا الذين آمنوا (بآياتنا) attached to (كذّبوا), (الفاء) the connective of the apodosis (في العذاب) attached to (محضرون), the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «الذين كفروا ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause الذين آمنوا ...).
The clause «كفروا..» has no grammatical position (ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين)).
The clause «كذّبوا ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the ṣila clause).
The clause «أولئك.. محضرون» is in the position of a nominative (khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين)).

* Morphology:
(روضة): a name for a garden or for Paradise; its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
- Singing in Paradise:
It is related on the authority of ʿAlī, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "In Paradise there is a gathering of the ḥūr al-ʿīn (the wide-eyed maidens), who raise their voices in a way the creatures have never heard the like of. They say: We are the everlasting, so we do not perish; we are the blissful, so we never despair; we are the content, so we are never displeased; blessed is the one who is for us and for whom we are.."

safi-cedvel:17-19.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive (سبحان) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, accusative (حين) an accusative adverbial attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) سبحان in the three places; the two verbs (تمسون, تصبحون) are complete verbs, that is, "you enter the evening and the morning", (الواو) parenthetical (له) attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) fronted for the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الحمد) (في السموات) attached to الحمد [Note: al-ʿUkbarī attached it to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الحمد, but the operator in it is weak.], (عشيّا) an accusative adverbial attached to سبحان, so it is conjoined to حين (من الميّت) attached to the first (يخرج) (من الحيّ) attached to the second (يخرج) (بعد) an accusative adverbial attached to (يحيي), (الواو) a conjunction (كذلك) attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq whose operator is تخرجون [Note: that is, "you will be brought out of the graves, an extraction like the extraction mentioned before."], and the (الواو) in it is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause « (سبّحوا) سبحان..» has no grammatical position (resumptive).
The clause «تمسون..» is in the position of a genitive (muḍāf ilayhi).
The clause «تصبحون..» is in the position of a genitive (muḍāf ilayhi).
The clause «له الحمد..» has no grammatical position (parenthetical).
The clause «تظهرون..» is in the position of a genitive (muḍāf ilayhi).
The clause «يخرج..» has no grammatical position (resumptive).
The clause «يخرج (الثانية..) ..» has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause يخرج (the first)).
The clause «يحيي ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause يخرج (the second)).
The clause «تخرجون..» has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause يحيي).

* Benefits:
1- The meanings of «أصبح, أمسى and أضحى» are three:
a- That the content of the sentence coincides with the times proper to them, namely morning, evening and forenoon.
b- That they give the meaning of entering these times; in this case they are complete verbs, satisfied with their nominative. Ḥumayd al-Arqaṭ said:
فأصبحوا والنوى عالى معرسّهم ... وليس كل النوى تلقي المساكين
(They entered the morning while the destination was far above their camping-place; and not every destination casts down the poor.)
c- That they carry the meaning of صار (became), as in our saying: أصبح عليّ فارسا (ʿAlī became a horseman), and أمسى خالد كريما (Khālid became generous).
2- The variety of colours and tongues:
Truly, when a person reflects on how each individual of mankind has been singled out with a colour and features that distinguish him from others, how these languages have sprung forth and these tongues have differed among the peoples of the earth, and how each group of people has agreed on a language of their own which they master to the exclusion of other languages, truly that fills the soul with wonder, the mind with awe, and the hearts with reverence for the Creator of the universe, the Disposer of its affairs, who spreads His signs throughout its regions. But where are the minds that perceive, the souls that are fair, and the hearts that understand...?

safi-cedvel:20-27.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction (من آياته) attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) fronted for the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun).. and likewise in the five places that follow (أن) a maṣdar particle (من تراب) attached to (خلقكم) (ثمّ) a conjunction (إذا) the particle of suddenness.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن خلقكم) is in the position of a nominative, a delayed mubtadaʾ.
The clause «من آياته أن خلقكم ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause يخرج الحيّ....).
The clause «خلقكم..» has no grammatical position (ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن)).
The clause «أنتم بشر ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the ṣila clause of the particle-relative).
The clause «تنتشرون ... » is in the position of a nominative (naʿt (adjective) of بشر) [Note: or it is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ أنتم.].
(21) (الواو) a conjunction (لكم) attached to (خلق), (من أنفسكم) attached to (خلق) [Note: or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (أزواجا).], (اللام) of reason (تسكنوا) an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن after the lām, its sign of accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and the (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent) (إليها) attached to (تسكنوا)..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تسكنوا ... ) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to (خلق).
(بينكم) an accusative adverbial attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) whose operator is جعل [Note: or attached to (جعل), taking it in the sense of خلق or أوجد.], (في ذلك) attached to an omitted khabar of inna (اللام) of emphasis (آيات) the delayed ism of inna, accusative, its sign of accusative being the kasra.. and likewise the similar cases that follow (لقوم) attached to a naʿt of آيات.
The clause «من آياته أن خلق ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause من آياته أن خلقكم).
The clause «خلق....» has no grammatical position (ṣila of the particle-relative (أن)).
The clause «تسكنوا ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن)).
The clause «جعل ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause خلق لكم).
The clause «إنّ في ذلك ... » has no grammatical position (an explanatory resumption or parenthetical).
The clause «يتفكّرون..» is in the position of a genitive (naʿt of قوم).
(22) (خلق) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative (الواو) a conjunction in the three places (اختلاف) conjoined to the mubtadaʾ خلق, nominative.
The clause «من آياته خلق ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause من آياته أن خلقكم).
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ... » has no grammatical position (an explanatory resumption - or parenthetical) - (23) (منامكم) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative (بالليل) attached to the maṣdar منامكم (من فضله) attached to the maṣdar (ابتغاؤكم).
The clause «من آياته منامكم ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause من آياته أن خلقكم).
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ... » has no grammatical position (an explanatory resumption - or parenthetical) - (24) (الواو) a conjunction (يريكم) an imperfect verb, nominative - the maṣdar particle being implied before it by analogy with the verbs mentioned before - [Note: it is permissible that (من آياته) be a ḥāl of (البرق), the clause then being verbal, conjoined to the nominal clause (من آياته أن خلقكم).].
(خوفا) a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative (من السماء) attached to (ينزّل), (الفاء) a conjunction (به) attached to (يحيي), and the (الباء) is causal (بعد) an accusative adverbial attached to (يحيي).
The clause «من آياته (إراءتكم ... ) » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause من آياته أن خلقكم).
The clause «يريكم..» has no grammatical position (ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن)).
The clause «ينزّل ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause يريكم).
The clause «يحيي ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause ينزّل).
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ... » has no grammatical position (an explanatory resumption - or parenthetical) - and the clause «يعقلون..» is in the position of a genitive (naʿt of قوم).
(25) (الواو) a conjunction (بأمره) attached to a ḥāl of السماء and الأرض (ثمّ) a conjunction (إذا) an adverbial of future time containing the meaning of condition, attached to the content of the apodosis (دعوة) a mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative (من الأرض) attached to (دعاكم), (إذا) the particle of suddenness - and the clause «من آياته أن تقوم ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause من آياته أن خلقكم).
The clause «تقوم السماء ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the particle-relative (أن)).
The clause «دعاكم ... » is in the position of a genitive (muḍāf ilayhi).
The clause «أنتم تخرجون..» has no grammatical position (apodosis of a non-jussive condition).
The clause «تخرجون..» is in the position of a nominative (khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم)).
(26) (الواو) a conjunction (له) attached to an omitted khabar fronted for the mubtadaʾ (من), (في السموات) attached to an omitted ṣila of من (كل) a mubtadaʾ, nominative - and the tanwīn in it is a substitute for something omitted, that is, "every created being" - (له) attached to the khabar (قانتون).
The clause «له من في السموات..» has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause من آياته أن تقوم).
The clause «كلّ له قانتون.» has no grammatical position (an explanatory resumption).
(27) (الواو) a conjunction (هو الذي ... يعيده) its i'rab has been given earlier [Note: in verse (11) of this surah.], (الواو) circumstantial - or parenthetical - and the pronoun (هو) refers to the creation, or the repetition, or the return, understood from the context (عليه) attached to (أهون), (الواو) a conjunction (له المثل) like له من.... (في السموات) attached to a ḥāl from the pronoun in الأعلى (الواو) a conjunction (الحكيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «هو الذي....» has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause له من في السموات).
The clause «يبدأ ... » has no grammatical position (ṣila of the relative noun (الذي)).
The clause «يعيده ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the ṣila clause).
The clause «هو أهون ... » has no grammatical position (parenthetical) - or is in the position of an accusative ḥāl - and the clause «له المثل ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause هو الذي....).
The clause «هو العزيز ... » has no grammatical position (conjoined to the clause هو الذي....).

* Morphology:
(أهون): a noun of comparison (ism tafḍīl) by which description, not comparison, is intended; its pattern is أفعل, from the triliteral verb (هان).

* Rhetoric:
The device of al-laff: in the words of the Exalted «وَمِنْ آياتِهِ مَنامُكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهارِ وَابْتِغاؤُكُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ» this belongs to the category of al-laff (folding), and its order is: "and among His signs are your sleeping and your seeking of His bounty, by night and by day"; except that the last two members were separated, because they are two times, and time and what occurs in it are like one thing, with the folding helping towards unity. It is also possible that what is meant is "your sleeping in both times, and your seeking in both"; but the apparent sense is the first, because it recurs in the Qur'an, and the soundest meanings are those the Qur'an indicates, which they hear with attentive ears.

* Benefits:
1- The particle أن may be omitted and the verb put in the position of the maṣdar. Among that is the well-known proverb:
تسمع بالمعيدي خير من أن تراه.
(That you hear of al-Muʿaydī is better than that you see him.)
The first to utter it was al-Mundhir ibn Māʾ al-Samāʾ.
He had admired the reports about al-Muʿaydī, and when he stood before him and saw his ugliness he said the aforementioned proverb.
The implied form is: أن تسمع بالمعيدي etc.
2- It is a condition that the agent of the verb and of what follows it as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi be the same. For this reason Ibn Mālik answered in Sharḥ al-Tasḥīl that the meaning of يريكم is "He makes you see", and thereby the agent of the verb «يريكم» and the agent of the fear and the hope become one. So reflect...!
